# omx upward

Lifts what is quiet toward a threshold, by a ratio and up to a limit, and leaves the loud alone.

- CLAP id: `org.openmixer.upward`
- LV2 URI: `urn:openmixer:upward`
- Parameters: 5, plus the host's bypass

## Audio ports

| Direction | Name | Role | Channels |
|---|---|---|---|
| in | in | main | 2 (stereo) |
| out | out | main | 2 (stereo) |

## Pages

A page is where a host shows a parameter. In LV2 each page is a port group, `pg:group <urn:openmixer:upward#<symbol>>`, whose `lv2:displayPriority` is the number below (a host that shows the higher first, as Zynthian does, shows the pages in port order). In CLAP each page is the module of its parameters (`clap_param_info.module`), the page labels joined by `/`.

| Page | LV2 group symbol | Priority | CLAP module | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Upward | `upward` | 1 | `Upward` | 5 |

## Parameters

Ids are the order below, 0 to 4; a parameter appended later takes the next id. The bypass's id is its own (below).

| Id | Symbol | Name | Unit | Min | Max | Default | Step or values | Flags | Page (priority) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `thresholdDb` | Threshold | dB | -70 | 0 | -40 | continuous, linear | automatable | Upward (1) |
| 1 | `ratio` | Ratio | ratio | 1 | 10 | 1 | continuous, linear | automatable | Upward (1) |
| 2 | `rangeDb` | Range | dB | 0 | 24 | 6 | continuous, linear | automatable | Upward (1) |
| 3 | `attackMs` | Attack | ms | 0.1 | 100 | 5 | continuous, linear | automatable | Upward (1) |
| 4 | `releaseMs` | Release | ms | 5 | 3000 | 200 | whole steps | automatable | Upward (1) |

## Bypass

CLAP: the host's bypass, a parameter named Bypass at id 2147418112 (0x7FFF0000) in every plugin, flagged automatable, stepped and bypass; 0 is processing, 1 bypassed. The id never moves when a parameter is appended.
LV2: the port `enabled` (`lv2:designation lv2:enabled`) at index 0, 1 is processing, 0 is bypassed; the output port `latency` at index 1 reports the latency in frames. Both come before the audio and parameter ports in every plugin, so neither moves; a preset or a session names a port by its symbol.
